tpl.admin.diag.title: Diagnostics
tpl.admin.diag.support_intro: If you need support please check the following links first before you create a new issue:
tpl.admin.diag.support_text_1: You can use the button below to pre-generate a string which you can copy/paste on either the Forum or when Creating a new issue at Github.
tpl.admin.diag.support_text_2: We try to hide the most sensitive values from the generated support string by default, but please verify if there is nothing in there which you want to hide!
tpl.admin.diag.title_prerelease: You are using a pre-release version.
tpl.admin.diag.title_env_overwritten: Environment variables are overwritten by a config.json.
tpl.admin.diag.title_config_load_error: Config file could not be loaded and was ignored. Check server logs for details.
tpl.admin.diag.title_invalid_env_vars: Invalid environment variables are found and defaults are used instead.
tpl.admin.diag.title_ip_header_valid: IP_HEADER config seems to be valid.
tpl.admin.diag.title_ip_header_invalid: IP_HEADER config seems to be invalid. IP's in the log could be invalid. Please fix.
tpl.admin.diag.title_internet_error: There seems to be no internet access. Please fix.
tpl.admin.diag.title_proxy_yes: Internet access goes via a proxy (HTTPS_PROXY or HTTP_PROXY is configured).
tpl.admin.diag.title_proxy_no: We have direct internet access, no outgoing proxy configured.
tpl.admin.diag.title_websocket_error: Websocket connection error, validate your reverse proxy configuration!
tpl.admin.diag.title_websocket_enabled: Websocket connections are enabled (ENABLE_WEBSOCKET is true).
tpl.admin.diag.title_websocket_disabled: Websocket connections are disabled (ENABLE_WEBSOCKET is false).
tpl.admin.diag.title_server_browser_ok: Server and browser times are within 15 seconds of each other.
tpl.admin.diag.title_server_browser_erro: Server and browser times are more than 15 seconds apart.
tpl.admin.diag.title_server_ntp_ok: Server and NTP times are within 15 seconds of each other.
tpl.admin.diag.title_server_ntp_error: Server and NTP times are more than 15 seconds apart.
tpl.admin.diag.title_browser_ntp_ok: Browser and NTP times are within 15 seconds of each other.
tpl.admin.diag.title_browser_ntp_error: Browser and NTP times are more than 15 seconds apart.
tpl.admin.diag.title_domain_match: The domain variable matches the browser location and seems to be configured correctly.
tpl.admin.diag.title_domain_no_match: The domain variable does not match the browser location. The domain variable does not seem to be configured correctly. Some features may not work as expected!
tpl.admin.diag.title_https_not_configure: Not configured to use HTTPS. Some features may not work as expected!
tpl.admin.diag.title_http_ok: All headers and HTTP request responses seem to be ok.
tpl.admin.diag.title_http_error: Some headers or HTTP request responses return invalid data!
tpl.admin.diag.title_invalid_flags: Some feature flags are invalid or outdated!
